candidates.change_summary: Change the comparison to require that depositsCount decreases (wrap/underflow prevented by Solidity 0.8 so requires depositsCount + 1 < depositsCount) causing receive to revert unless impossible.
Remove the require check so depositsCount increments unconditionally when receive is called.
Add an additional increment so depositsCount increases by two on each receive call.
Change increment to decrement so depositsCount is decreased when receive is called.
Replace increment with explicit assignment to zero, resetting depositsCount on each receive.
Replace body to transfer the full balance to owner directly instead of calling withdraw(uint), so withdrawAll's visible effect (balance sent) and reentrancy footprint differ.
Replace body to do nothing (remove the withdrawal), so after calling withdrawAll the contract balance remains and observable behavior differs.
Change the access check to require msg.sender != owner instead of ==, inverting the guard so withdrawAll can be called by non-owners and thus observable behavior (who can withdraw) changes.
Replace the transfer to send funds to owner (state variable) instead of msg.sender, so withdraw sends funds to the contract owner rather than the caller.
Replace the transfer with a no-op (commented-out transfer) effectively preventing any funds from being sent during withdraw.
Replace the transfer with a transfer of a fixed different amount (1 wei) regardless of requested _value, changing post-withdraw balances.
Change the onlyOwner modifier to require the caller is NOT the owner, inverting access control and thereby altering which calls to withdraw succeed.

Replace the low-level call with a call that forwards all remaining gas and reverts on failure (using require on call success), making sendMoney revert on remote failure which can change post-call state observation.

Replace the low-level call with a low-level staticcall (which disallows state changes on target) — this will change behavior when the target expects to receive value or mutate state, affecting observable state after sendMoney.
Replace the call to use transfer (which forwards a fixed 2300 gas and reverts on failure), changing behavior when target requires more gas or reentrancy occurs.
Change onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller (remove require), which permits non-owners to invoke sendMoney and thus can alter observable state after sendMoney.
